nodes.description: Constant string state variable NAME = "Ether(Wrapped)" used as the ERC20 name passed to the ERC20 constructor.
Constant string state variable SYMBOL = "WETH" used as the ERC20 symbol passed to the ERC20 constructor.
Constant uint state variable DECIMALS = 18 used to compute the initial supply.
Mutable uint state variable INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * 10**DECIMALS, minted to the deployer; declared non-constant so it could be changed in storage.
ERC20 private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances.
ERC20 private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances holding spending approvals.
ERC20 private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total token supply.
ERC20 private string _name storing the token name.
ERC20 private string _symbol storing the token symbol.
EtherWrapped constructor; calls ERC20(NAME, SYMBOL) and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender.
ERC20 internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount); increases _totalSupply and _balances[account] and calls the transfer hooks.
Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount); forwards to _transfer using _msgSender().
Internal ERC20 _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); performs balance checks and writes balances.
Public ERC20 transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); transfers and updates allowance in an unchecked block.
Public ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 amount); forwards to _approve using _msgSender() as owner.
Internal ERC20 _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount); writes the allowance mapping.
Public ERC20 increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue); adds to the existing allowance without overflow check.
Public ERC20 decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue); subtracts from allowance inside an unchecked block.
Public view ERC20 balanceOf(address account); returns _balances[account].
Public view ERC20 totalSupply(); returns _totalSupply.
Public view ERC20 name(); returns _name.
Public view ERC20 symbol(); returns _symbol.
Public view ERC20 decimals(); returns the constant 18.
Public view ERC20 allowance(address owner, address spender); returns the nested allowance mapping value.
Internal ERC20 _burn(address account, uint256 amount); decreases balance and _totalSupply and calls transfer hooks.
Overridable internal hook _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount); empty in ERC20 but invoked before all state changes of transfer/mint/burn.
Overridable internal hook _afterTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount); empty in ERC20 and invoked after all state changes.
Context internal view _msgSender(); returns msg.sender and is the indirection point for the caller identity.
Context internal view _msgData(); returns msg.data.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller identity, used for minting in the constructor and as the owner in transfer/approve flows.
_mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY) inside the constructor: the entire 1,000,000e18 supply is minted to the deployer with no access control or distribution logic.
_totalSupply += amount inside _mint: unchecked-style supply increase that can overflow in pre-0.8 compilation modes.
_balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer: unchecked recipient balance increase.
unchecked { _approve(sender, _msgSender(), currentAllowance - amount) } in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction of the spent allowance.
unchecked { _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount } in _transfer: unchecked sender balance subtraction.
unchecked { _approve(_msgSender(), spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue) } in decreaseAllowance: unchecked allowance subtraction.
unchecked { _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount } in _burn: unchecked balance subtraction.
_totalSupply -= amount in _burn: unchecked supply decrease.
Constructor parameter name_ (ERC20 constructor) used to initialize _name.
Constructor parameter symbol_ (ERC20 constructor) used to initialize _symbol.
Parameter address account of _mint, the recipient of newly created tokens.
Parameter uint256 amount of _mint, added to both _totalSupply and the account balance.
Parameter address recipient of the public transfer function.
Parameter uint256 amount of the public transfer function.
Parameter address sender of transferFrom, the account whose allowance and balance are debited.
Parameter address recipient of transferFrom.
Parameter uint256 amount of transferFrom, used in the allowance subtraction.
Parameter address spender of the public approve function.
Parameter uint256 amount of the public approve function.
Parameter address owner of _approve / allowance.
Parameter address spender of the internal _approve function.
Parameter uint256 amount written into the allowance mapping by _approve.
Parameter uint256 addedValue of increaseAllowance, added to the existing allowance.
Parameter uint256 subtractedValue of decreaseAllowance, subtracted from the existing allowance.
Parameter address sender of the internal _transfer function.
Parameter uint256 amount of the internal _transfer function, used in the balance subtraction.
Parameter address account of _burn, whose balance is reduced.
Parameter uint256 amount of _burn, subtracted from the balance and the total supply.
Parameter address from of the _beforeTokenTransfer/_afterTokenTransfer hooks.
Parameter address to of the token transfer hooks.
Parameter uint256 amount of the token transfer hooks.
Parameter address account of balanceOf, used as the index into _balances.
Local uint256 currentAllowance in transferFrom read from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].
Local uint256 senderBalance in _transfer read from _balances[sender].
Local uint256 accountBalance in _burn read from _balances[account].
Local uint256 currentAllowance in decreaseAllowance read from _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].
